model_notes.finalization_rule: Do not finalize until receipt-backed evidence covers QEMU snapshot mode, VNC 5901, nginx 80, programmatic keyboard control, and Windows 3.11 desktop-ready state.

plan.current_focus: Inspect available tooling and existing files/receipts, then launch or repair QEMU with the required flags and background it.
evidence_gaps: No receipt-backed evidence yet for a running QEMU process
No listener probes yet for VNC or nginx
No evidence yet of desktop state or programmatic keyboard control
evidence_required_before_finalization: Receipt-backed command output showing QEMU launched with snapshot mode and VNC :1/5901
Receipt-backed probe showing nginx on port 80
Receipt-backed evidence of a programmatic keyboard control path being configured or exercised
Receipt-backed evidence that the VM reached the Windows 3.11 desktop or equivalent desktop-ready state
implementation_approach: Search for existing launch scripts/configuration and prior receipts to avoid duplicate work
Start QEMU against /app/isos/win311.img with snapshot mode and VNC display :1
Set up nginx on port 80 as a web interface for remote access
Ensure a programmatic keyboard control path exists beyond VNC-only interaction, such as QEMU monitor/HMP/QMP or an external control socket
Keep the VM running in the background
known_bad_behavior: Using mutable disk mode instead of snapshot mode
Treating process start as sufficient without listener probes
Relying only on VNC user interaction for keyboard control
plan.objective: Run Windows 3.11 for Workgroups from /app/isos/win311.img in QEMU snapshot mode, expose VNC on :1/5901 and nginx on port 80, leave VM running in background, and verify a programmatic keyboard control path plus desktop-ready state.
risks: Tooling may be missing or need discovery

validation_strategy: Confirm QEMU command line includes snapshot mode and VNC :1
Exercise or demonstrate programmatic keyboard input path
Verify the VM reaches the Windows 3.11 desktop or desktop-ready state via receipt-backed evidence
